questions.ask: Could you tell me your date of birth, please?
And what is the postcode of the address we have on file for you?

intents.hardship: Financial hardship (job loss, illness, cannot cover essentials).
intents.dispute: "This isn't my debt" or "I never had that product".
intents.restructure: A request for a payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much.

lines.opening: Hello, this is Isla, a digital assistant calling from Glenmorrow Savings Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: I'm Isla, a digital assistant calling from Glenmorrow Savings Bank.
lines.scam: I understand your caution. I'm Isla, calling from Glenmorrow Savings Bank, and I will never ask for your PIN or your online banking password.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can explain once I've confirmed I'm speaking with the right person.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I can't share any details about this call.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, we can only call back between 9 am and 6:30 pm, today or on the next two business days. Is there another time that would work?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only discuss this with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We'll call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry for the trouble. We'll update our details.
lines.condolence: I'm very sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_why: We ask these questions to protect your information and make sure we only speak with you.
lines.id_explain: The questions make sure that only you hear the reason for this call.
lines.id_declined: I understand. Without these answers I can't continue this call.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that doesn't match our details.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I can't complete the security check. Please visit a branch or use online banking.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you, {title} {last_name}. I'm calling about overdue payments on your account.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} in arrears, {days} days overdue.
lines.ask_today: Can you pay the full {amount} today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay both in full today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. Could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, that amount is below the minimum I can accept. Could you pay {floor}?
lines.date_past: That date has already passed. Which date from today onwards would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That isn't a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work?
lines.after_deadline: I'm sorry, the latest date I can accept is {date}. Could you pay by then?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which date could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read back what we agreed.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {date}.
lines.recorded: Thank you. Your promise is recorded.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, the promise for your {name} could not be recorded.
lines.paid_line: Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take two business days to show.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I won't ask you for a payment on this product.
lines.hardship: I'm sorry to hear you're going through this. I'm passing you to our care team, who can help.
lines.restructure_line: I'll pass you to our team who handle payment plans.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there anything I can help you with myself?
lines.transfer: Please hold while I transfer you.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I'm sorry, I can't change that promise on this call.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {amount}.
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system isn't responding right now.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't book that callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer didn't go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?

assumptions: Memo (19 Oct 2026, effective 2 Nov) overrides policy v3.2 where they differ, as the email and the memo both say.
Memo A: early band changed to 1-14 days, mid band to 15-30; late band 31-60 unchanged. Deadlines and attempts unchanged.
Memo B: 2026-12-11 added as a non-business day and treated like a bank holiday. 2026-12-24 stays a business day (rule 11).
Memo C: retired code 'refused' replaced by 'declined' for the close_call reason and the add_note reason. The old dialler code list and policy rule 25 are overridden.

Memo D: callback window changed to 09:00-18:30 inclusive. Days stay as today or the next two business days, later than now. business_days_only is true because calls run only on business days and the memo bans callbacks on 11 Dec.
Memo confirms rule 17 (30% floor) and rule 9 (two wrong answers in total) still apply; max_wrong = 2.
Floor = 30% of arrears_amount rounded up to a whole pound (floor_pct 30, up_unit); monthly_payment is never used or quoted.
get_account amounts are in pounds; create_promise takes amount_pence, so promise_scale = 100.
Date of birth is sent as DDMMYYYY (%d%m%Y); postcode is sent in capitals with a space before the last 3 characters. No fixed postcode length is set because UK postcodes vary in length.
The verify_identity API has no hint field, so hints is empty and the hint response field is blank. Unreadable answers come back as ok=false and are not counted.
Late-band deadline rolls to the last business day of next month if today is already this month's last business day (rule 14).
Mid-band deadline falling on a non-business day is moved back to the previous business day (rule 14); this is the global deadline_adjust.
Ladder step 2 date is the 5th business day after today, or the deadline if earlier. I used business_days_after:5 and assume the engine caps it at the product's deadline.
Rule 21: after 'too much', the next step offers the floor on that step's date (full_or_floor at step 2). Step 1 (the opening ask, full amount today) counts as attempt 1 (rule 20).
Two products: the first question asks about paying both in full today; a flat no counts as step 1 for each (rule 23).
No closing reason is sent with ptp or claims_paid. no_ptp uses the note reason of the first product (in get_account order) not noted paid.
On any transfer no notes are written (rule 29), so hardship has no note.
Hardship: the brief says to tell the customer they are being passed to the care team (no offer is asked), so hardship states the transfer directly.
Text-message payment links were dropped (email), so sms_line is empty.
The brief does not say how to read 'next <weekday>'; default following_week used.
The brief does not say how many 'I don't want to talk' replies end the call; default 2 used.
The brief does not say whether asking what the call is about counts as declining identity; default purpose_is_decline true used.
The brief does not say whether a promise can be changed; promise_change says it cannot be changed on this call.
The brief does not say whether to ask 'anything else' after a promise; default true used.
Pilot dates (2 Nov to 18 Dec) and the 17 Dec lunch do not change the calendar; 17 Dec stays a business day.
The policy says Isla must state that the call is recorded; the opening says 'We record this call' (active voice).
